description: Buy a product with your credits; the data ships inline in the response. Deliverable today: the whole depin_* family plus depin_intel_bundle — call list_products for the live prices rather than trusting a figure restated here, which is how a price in a second place drifts from the first. The signal_*, dag_* and mcp_unlimited keys are priced but return 503 not_yet_deliverable — they are deliberately blocked, not broken, because nothing grants their entitlement yet. Credits buy DATA; they do not change your access tier. Use api_key from register_agent.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any stable string unique to THIS intended purchase (e.g. a uuid). If a network error makes you retry the same call, re-send the SAME idempotency_key: the retry returns the same receipt and re-delivers the data without a second charge.

product_key.description: Product key to purchase (e.g. dag_pro, mcp_unlimited)

name: purchase_data
